s.4cda26a4e452cbe2: «Preservation alone would have earned the world’s thanks, since some ancient works survive only through Arabic. But the translators’ heirs did something better: they argued back. Ptolemy’s star positions were remeasured and corrected, Galen was challenged from the dissection room, Aristotle was annotated until commentary became original philosophy. When Europe grew hungry in the twelfth century, it came to Toledo and translated the Arabic, corrections, commentaries, and all; Gerard of Cremona alone carried some seventy works into Latin. s.4d8040eec89e64c0: «By his early thirties he held the most prestigious teaching post in the Muslim world, the Nizamiyya college of Baghdad, lecturing to hundreds, consulted by rulers, unbeaten in debate. Physicians found nothing wrong with his body and said the illness was in his heart. He had begun to examine his own motives and found ambition wearing the mask of piety, and he could not unsee it. s.5e5c12abc3369641: «At Maragheh, in the hills of northwestern Iran, Nasir al-Din al-Tusi persuaded the Mongol conqueror Hulagu to fund something new in 1259: a great observatory with a library, salaried staff, and scholars drawn from across Eurasia, a Chinese astronomer working beside Muslims and others on one long program of observation. Astronomy became team science with an address. s.d1094e9637530a94: «The first war did not end the jinn; it unseated them. The Qur’an lets them speak for themselves, long after: ‘among us are the righteous, and among us are other than that; we were on divergent paths’ (72:11); ‘among us are those who submit, and among us are the unjust’ (72:14). They believe and rebel beside us still, unseen tenants of the earth they once held alone. And the sky some of them once approached is sealed: they found it ‘filled with mighty guards and burning flames’, and whoever steals a hearing now finds ‘a flame lying in wait’ (72:8-9). The earth itself passed to a creature of clay who can corrupt it exactly as the angels feared, and can also carry the trust that the heavens declined (33:72). Read with all its grades showing, the first war leaves one lesson: the earth is inherited by worship, not by strength, and pride after victory is how the highest fall.»
